# IEEE SPS @ UF - Chapter Website

> Official website for the IEEE Signal Processing Society chapter at the University of Florida, including mission, leadership, events, projects, resources, and membership information.

Use this file as the primary LLM entry point for the chapter site hosted at `https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/`.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/): Chapter overview, current priorities, and highlights.
- [About](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/about.html): Chapter mission, leadership context, and organization details.
- [Events](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/events.html): Upcoming and recent chapter events.
- [Projects](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/projects.html): Technical and community project work.
- [Resources](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/resources.html): Links, tools, and materials for students and members.
- [Join](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/join.html): Membership and participation guidance.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/sitemap.xml): Complete list of chapter site URLs.
- [Robots](https://ieee-sps-uf.raulv.dev/robots.txt): Crawl policy and sitemap declaration.

## Optional

- [Main Personal Site](https://www.raulv.dev/): Related personal academic website for Raul Valle.
